mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the federal funds rate is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates and reducing corporate borrowing capacity, regardless of the absolute level of the rate.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above its 5-year median, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month signal a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in < 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime (INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months), a rise in the federal funds rate leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as monetary tightening exacerbates supply constraints and reduces corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO declines > 0.5% in 3 months and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the CPI inflation rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals rising inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as stronger housing activity signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST is above its 5-year median, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signal a broad economic contraction, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to falling corporate earnings and reduced investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline in the prior quarter, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), a further decline in the unemployment rate signals overheating labor market conditions and impending monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5% and declines in the prior month, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
